```{r setup}
if(!require(readr)){install.packages('readr')}
library(readr)
if(!require(tidyverse)){install.packages('tidyverse')}
library(tidyverse) 

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/Volumes/fsmresfiles/MSS/Schleider_Lab/jslab/ED SSI Delphi Study")
setwd("/Volumes/fsmresfiles/MSS/Schleider_Lab/jslab/ED SSI Delphi Study")

phase2_round1 <- read_csv("Data/phase2_round1.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) #data exported with values (not labels) and all variables assigned character class for later conversion to correct class
```

```{r initial cleaning}
#Delete first two rows (item labeling)
phase2_round1 <- phase2_round1[-c(1,2), ]

#NOTE: Will merge datasets here (will need to create a variable to identify phase 1 vs phase 2 participants)
```

```{r transforming data}
#Create categorical variables
phase2_round1 <- phase2_round1 %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(contains("aim2r1_expert_group"),
      contains("aim2r1_prvntion_"),
      contains("aim2r1_ident_"),
      contains("aim2r1_ir_"),
      contains("aim2r1_treatmnt_"),
      contains("aim2r1_psorsrpt_")),
    as.factor))

#NOTE: Worrying about demographics etc later, just focusing now on what needs to be cleaned for narrowing bridge items for rounds 2 and 3
```
